newsitem.title: UK: BOC's advance triggered by price increases.
newsitem.headline: BOC's advance triggered by price increases.

text.p: Shares in BOC Group Plc advanced on Thursday after news of further price increases in the U.S. industrial gas market boosted optimism over future prospects for the industry.
The shares bucked the weaker market trend to be up 12p at 944-1/2p by 0959 GMT.
U.S. industrial gas supplier, Praxair Inc said on Wednesday carbon dioxide prices in the U.S. will be raised by an average four percent and hydrogen prices by around seven percent from May 1.
Praxair commented that it was experiencing rising gas costs and tight supply for carbon dioxide and a much higher rate of government and commercial consumption of hydrogen.
The company is the largest industrial gas supplier in North and South America, with annual sales of US$4.4 billion.

"It is a comment on the state of the market, the fact that the North American market is able to absorb more increases after the pricing environment has been firm for a couple of years," said Peter Cartwright, industry analyst at Williams de Broe.
"It is all positive noise for BOC...confirmation that the market is still solid."
Shares in BOC have underperformed the FTSE All-Share index by around five percent during the last month, after reaching a peak of 10.32-1/2 stg on March 10.
